title: SOS MCP Services: Model Context Protocol Microservices Suite for Scientific and Bibliometric Intelligence
description: SOS MCP Services is a monorepo suite of FastMCP microservices providing dual transport (stdio and HTTP/SSE) for AI agents and LLMs to interact with the UNAM scientific intelligence ecosystem, including Self-Organizing Maps (knoMap), GraphRAG (SinapsisAI), bibliometric laws (PLmetrix), journal analytics (RevistasLATAM), research front detection (Topics), and local ClickHouse OpenAlex querying.
